title: platform.diagnostics_round_trip_recorded v2
description: Additive dual-read companion to v1. Adds an optional machine source identifier. Producers still emit v1; consumers accept both until a later phase switches the producer (events/README.md).

diagnostics_id.description: Identifier of the synthetic diagnostics record committed in the same transaction.

label.description: Machine-generated slug identifying a test run.

echo_delay_ms.description: Artificial delay the consumer applies before marking the event processed.

recorded_at.description: UTC instant the diagnostics record was written, assigned inside the transaction.

source.description: Optional producer identity. Additive in v2; v1 consumers ignore unknown fields only after dual-read is deployed, so this field is omitted by the current producer.
